# Karak Tea (karaktea.com)

> Karak Tea is a Kuwait-based beverage brand producing premium instant karak tea
> premixes. Karak Tea is a registered trademark owned by San Ramon General Trading
> (Kuwait) and manufactured in India by Aastha Enterprises, a dedicated karak tea
> production factory. The site is bilingual: English (/) and Arabic (/ar/).

Karak is strong, milky tea made by repeatedly boiling tea — an Urdu term adopted
across the Gulf region through historic trade with India. Karak Tea premixes are
made from fine Kenyan tea enriched with milk and premium sugarcane extract, with
no preservatives or artificial food coloring. All flavors prepare in under a
minute, sweetened or unsweetened.

## Products

- Flavors: Original, Cardamom, Kashmiri Saffron, Coffee, Ginger, Cinnamon
- Formats: easy-tear premix packs (also 500g / 1kg bags), unsweetened variants,
  ICED Karak Tea, and Dolce Gusto compatible capsules
- Vending machines: karak tea vending machines and refills are also sold
- Online store (prices and ordering): https://thiafa.com/en/
- Products page: https://karaktea.com/products/

## Availability

- Middle East: Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Jordan,
  Palestine, Iraq
- International: Canada, United States, United Kingdom, Egypt, South Africa
- Delivery: within Kuwait in 24 hours; international shipping 3-5 working days
- Also stocked in cooperatives and major supermarkets
